$comment: The single source of truth for module boundaries. PRD 11.2 states them as a table;
this is that table in machine-readable form, and the table in docs/MODULES.md is
generated from here rather than maintained beside it.
Widening anything in this file is its own change, with its own justification, recorded
as an ADR. It is deliberately not something to edit in the same commit as the code that
wanted the wider boundary — that is how a boundary becomes a formality.

@atlasops/contracts.owns: Shared types, JSON schemas, error taxonomy, identifier formats

@atlasops/telemetry.owns: Span model, token and cost accounting, price table, budget assertions

@atlasops/governance.owns: Principal and group resolution, ACL labels, audit record writing

@atlasops/model-gateway.owns: Embedding, rerank and generation interfaces, provider adapters, retries, caching

@atlasops/corpus.owns: Source and SourceVersion model, provenance, corpus store, retention

@atlasops/ingest.owns: Connectors, parsers, chunkers, dedup, change detection, deletion

@atlasops/indexing.owns: Index adapters, schema migration, permission predicate compilation

@atlasops/retrieval.owns: Dense arm, lexical arm, RRF fusion, reranking, ablation switches

@atlasops/grounding.owns: Prompt assembly, answer schema, citation binding, verification, abstention

@atlasops/evalkit.owns: Harness, dataset loaders, metrics, ablation runner, statistics, reporting

$comment: The composition root (ADR 0005). It exists because apps/eval-runner must evaluate the
same answer pipeline apps/api serves, and an application may not import another
application — so without this the runner would rebuild the pipeline and an evaluation
could pass while the API served something else.
@atlasops/composition.owns: The answer and ingestion pipelines, assembled from ports

exhibits.owns: One exhibit's own code, fixtures, datasets, README, evidence

$comment: Provider SDKs are reachable from exactly one module. Everything above model-gateway
talks to an interface, which is what lets every downstream test run against the
deterministic fake instead of a paid API.
The same containment, keyed on the host. providerSdks catches an import; it cannot catch
fetch("https://api.openai.com/..."), because that is not an import. The OpenAI adapter is
written without an SDK (ADR 0006), so without this rule the gateway boundary would be
enforced against a shape nothing in this repository uses.
